title: Microsoft Exchange Server Zero-Day CVE-2026-42897 — Active OWA Spoofing, No Permanent Patch

CVE-2026-42897.evidence: 2897 — Active OWA Spoofing, No Permanent Patch Just 48 hours after Microsoft's first zero-day-free Patch Tuesday in nearly two years, a new actively exploited zero-day in on-premises Exchange Server was disclosed.
